entry.title: Market brief — 16 November 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on Monday 16 November 2026 the Nifty 50 closed at 25,291.10 (+146.80, +0.58%) and the Sensex at 82,104.79 (+512.34, +0.63%), with the rupee 27 paise stronger at 93.92 per dollar. IBJA's 12:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at Rs 1,34,380 per 10 g (-1,429) and 999 silver at Rs 1,69,280 per kg (-8,720). The next session is Tuesday 17 November 2026.
